intro: Public and cultural policy, social welfare, and health insurance research.

sections.title: A perspective shaped by experience
paragraphs: I-Chun Liu is a professor in the Department of Social and Policy Sciences and heads Student Affairs at Yuan Ze University. She is listed among the faculty associated with IBSC.

Her expertise includes public policy, cultural policy, administrative management, social welfare policy, and Taiwan’s National Health Insurance. She holds a doctorate in Public Administration and Policy from National Taipei University.

Her research connects policy and public services with social well-being. Recent listed publications consider museums and care for older adults, the social value of cultural institutions, and questions of health and welfare.
